sentences.en: All sins are forgiven in New York City.
sentences.zh: 在纽约市，所有的罪孽都会被原谅。

sentences.en: How We Made Your Mother is hosted and executive produced by Josh Radner and Craig Thomas.
sentences.zh: 《我们是如何创造你们母亲的》由乔什·雷德诺和克雷格·托马斯主持并担任执行制片人。

sentences.en: The show is produced by me, Alec Lev, and our co-producer is Doug Matica.
sentences.zh: 本节目由我亚历克·莱夫制作，我们的联合制片人是道格·马蒂卡。

sentences.en: Our audio producer and mixer is Alex Reeves at Point of Blue Studios.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频制作人和混音师是 Point of Blue 工作室的亚历克斯·里夫斯。

sentences.en: Artwork by John Morrow.
sentences.zh: 封面艺术由约翰·莫罗制作。

sentences.en: Please follow, rate, and review the show on Apple Podcasts or your podcast player of choice.
sentences.zh: 请在苹果播客或你选择的播客播放器上关注、评分并评论本节目。

sentences.en: It really does help the show.
sentences.zh: 这确实对节目很有帮助。

sentences.en: Our theme song is NYC by our own Josh Radner.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是由我们自己的乔希·拉德纳创作的《NYC》。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Lola Kennedy and Elliot Connors.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢萝拉·肯尼迪和埃利奥特·康纳斯。

sentences.en: Visit HowWeMadeYourMother.com to sign up for our substack mailing list and for links to our social media.
sentences.zh: 访问 HowWeMadeYourMother.com 注册我们的 Substack 邮件列表，并获取我们的社交媒体链接。

sentences.en: You can also click on the contact page to send us an email or a voice message.
sentences.zh: 您也可以点击联系页面向我们发送电子邮件或语音留言。

sentences.en: Your stories and questions are an important part of the show.
sentences.zh: 您的故事和问题是节目不可或缺的重要部分。

sentences.en: Subscribe to Josh Radner's Muse Letters on Substack.
sentences.zh: 在 Substack 上订阅乔希·拉德纳的“缪斯信”。

sentences.en: Read Craig Thomas' published prose at CraigThomasWriter.com.
sentences.zh: 在 CraigThomasWriter.com 阅读克雷格·托马斯的已出版散文。

sentences.en: And you can subscribe to my Dead Father's Society, also on Substack.
sentences.zh: 您也可以订阅我的“已故父亲社”，同样在 Substack 上。

sentences.en: To learn about how you make a difference, this show's ongoing campaign to raise money for congenital heart disease research,
sentences.zh: 要了解您如何能做出改变——本节目旨在为先天性心脏病研究筹集资金的长期活动——

sentences.en: check out the Make a Difference tab at the top of our website.
sentences.zh: 请查看我们网站顶部的“做出改变”标签页。

sentences.en: This episode was made possible by the support of Backyard Ventures, marketing provided by Tink Media.
sentences.zh: 本集得以制作要感谢 Backyard Ventures 的支持，营销由 Tink Media 提供。

sentences.en: People will, in fact, dance.
sentences.zh: 人们事实上确实会跳舞。

sentences.en: The real question, it just hit me, am I in love with you or just New York City?
sentences.zh: 真正的问题，我刚刚突然意识到，我是爱上了你，还是仅仅爱上了纽约市？
